overview.description:
At 99brightminds, we are dedicated to enabling businesses to thrive in their digital transformation journeys. As a leading provider of Offshore Development Centers, IT Staff Augmentation Solutions, Managed Software Teams, and CTO as a Service, we deliver tailored solutions designed to meet each client’s unique needs.

Strategically based in Jordan, a vibrant technology hub connecting the Middle East and Europe, with additional capabilities in Egypt and the West Bank, we leverage a diverse and highly skilled pool of IT professionals to provide innovative, scalable solutions. Our services cater to a wide range of industries, including Technology, Banking and Finance, Healthcare, Insurance, Manufacturing, Transport, Telecom, Energy, and Media, ensuring we bring specialized expertise to every project.
